preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()) == 1 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in [int(stdin.split()[i]) for i in range(1, 2*n-1, 2)])
preconditions.description: The first line is n, followed by n-1 edges where each edge connects two distinct vertices between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in [(int(stdin.split()[i]), int(stdin.split()[i+1])) for i in range(1, 2*n-1, 2)])
preconditions.description: Each query must consist of two vertices u and v within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len([line for line in stdin.split() if line.startswith('?')]) <= n // 2
preconditions.description: The number of queries made must not exceed ⌊n/2⌋.

postconditions.description: The final output must be a valid root vertex r (1 ≤ r ≤ n) in the format '! r'.

postconditions.expression: all('? u v' in line for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('?'))
postconditions.description: Every query must be formatted as '? u v' where u and v are valid vertices.

postconditions.expression: any('! r' in line for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The program must output exactly one '! r' line to indicate the root vertex.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout.split()[i]) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('?') for i in range(1, 3))
postconditions.description: All vertices u and v in queries must be within the valid range [1, n].
